the permeability and the Darcy–Forcheimer coefficient are porosity-dependent parameters that can be accurately predicted for any porosity in the 5%–95% range and for any flow condition in the Stokes flow, laminar flow and fully turbulent flow regimes.
the permeability and friction factor of a staggered square cylinder porous medium are strongly dependent on the Reynolds and porosity number, respectively.

the permeability of a staggered square cylinders porous medium can be correlated as a function of porosity and the friction factor of the medium can be correlated for a wide range of Reynolds numbers as a function of both porosity and Reynolds numbers.
